text: I wonder he didn’t meet the rescuing crowd.” “That would present no difficulties,” said Lemoine. “He would be a rescuer in advance of the rest, that was all.” “Do you really think this Arsène Lupin fellow is actually among the household now?” asked Bill, his eyes sparkling. “Why not?” said Lemoine. “He could pass perfectly as a servant. For all we may know, he may be Boris Anchoukoff, the trusted servant of the late Prince Michael.” “He is an odd-looking bloke,” agreed Bill.
